title: Bharat Semi Secures $24M Seed Round for AI Sensors
excerpt: Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in a seed funding round to target the global AI sensor market.
body_html:
Indian chip startup Bharat Semi has successfully raised $24 million in a seed funding round. The company is focusing on the global market for artificial intelligence sensors.

According to the startup, it has already secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology from multiple companies. Among these clients is General Atomics.

The newly acquired capital will support the company's ongoing efforts as it targets expansion within the international AI sensor sector.
